review_candidates.title: Contract / Site Manager
review_candidates.description: Als Contract Manager / Site Manager ben je verantwoordelijk voor de dagelijkse opvolging van technische onderhoudsactiviteiten op twee locaties. Je verantwoordelijkheden omvatten: Je coördineert de dagelijkse werkzaamheden van een team van ongeveer 4 à 5 techniekers, verdeeld over twee locaties. Je volgt nieuwe onderhoudsmeldingen en technische tickets op en bewaakt de correcte afhandeling ervan. Je houdt toezicht op de planning, uitvoering en kwaliteit van preventieve en correctieve onderhoudswerkzaamheden. Je controleert of werkzaamheden correct worden uitgevoerd volgens de geldende veiligheidsprocedures en contractuele afspraken. Je zorgt voor een nauwkeurige administratieve en operationele opvolging van de onderhoudsactiviteiten. Je fungeert als aanspreekpunt voor de klant en onderhoudt een professionele samenwerking met de betrokken partijen. Je volgt contractuele verplichtingen en gemaakte afspraken op, met bijzondere aandacht voor het vermijden van fouten en mogelijke contractuele boetes. Je bewaakt de kwaliteit en veiligheid van de dienstverlening en volgt de relevante operationele afspraken op. Je werkt samen met de Support Manager, die ondersteuning biedt bij de technische en operationele opvolging. De functie kan op twee manieren worden ingevuld, afhankelijk van je profiel: Operationeel en contractgericht Je legt de nadruk op dagelijkse coördinatie, ticketopvolging, klantcommunicatie, werkorganisatie en het bewaken van contractuele afspraken. Je zorgt ervoor dat werkzaamheden nauwkeurig worden opgevolgd en dat de dienstverlening gestructureerd verloopt. Technisch en sitegericht Je combineert de operationele opvolging met een grotere technische betrokkenheid. Je begrijpt de werking van gebouwinstallaties, kunt technische problemen beoordelen en ondersteunt de techniekers bij het opvolgen van technische vraagstukken. In beide gevallen blijft een nauwkeurige operationele opvolging de kern van de functie. Functie-eisen Wat breng je mee? Je beschikt over een bachelordiploma, bij voorkeur in een technische richting, of over relevante ervaring binnen technisch gebouwenbeheer of onderhoud. Je hebt ervaring met technische installaties of onderhoudsomgevingen, bijvoorbeeld elektriciteit, HVAC, beveiligingssystemen of andere gebouwtechnieken. Kennis van camerabewaking, toegangscontrole of elektrische installaties is een relevante troef. Je hebt ervaring met het aansturen of coördineren van technische medewerkers. Je werkt nauwkeurig, gestructureerd en volgt afspraken consequent op. Je voelt je comfortabel in een werkomgeving met vaste procedures, duidelijke veiligheidsvoorschriften en een strikte planning. Je houdt overzicht over meerdere lopende werkzaamheden en volgt technische meldingen systematisch op. Je communiceert duidelijk met klanten en medewerkers, ook wanneer gesprekken of situaties veeleisend zijn. Je bent stressbestendig en kunt professioneel omgaan met contractuele druk en kritische klantverwachtingen. Je spreekt vlot Nederlands en beschikt over een goede kennis van Frans en Engels. Je staat open voor een functie binnen een penitentiaire omgeving, waar veiligheid en naleving van procedures belangrijk zijn. Wat biedt onze klant aan? Je komt terecht bij een internationale technische dienstverlener met langdurige onderhoudscontracten en een gestructureerde werkomgeving. Het aanbod omvat: Een bruto maandloon tot ongeveer € 6.000, met bespreekbaarheid afhankelijk van ervaring en profiel. Een bedrijfswagen met tank- of laadkaart. Een netto-onkostenvergoeding. Een bonusregeling. Maaltijdcheques. Een smartphone met abonnement en laptop. Een groepsverzekering en hospitalisatieverzekering. Een dertiende maand. 32 verlofdagen per jaar, bestaande uit 20 vakantiedagen en 12 ADV-dagen. Mogelijkheid tot fietsleasing. Een flexibel verloningsplan. Kortingen bij partners. Ondersteuning door een ervaren Support Manager. De functie vereist aanwezigheid op locatie en kent een gestructureerde werkorganisatie met vaste afspraken. Thuiswerk en flexibele werkuren maken geen deel uit van deze functie. De verdeling van je aanwezigheid over de twee locaties en de precieze verantwoordelijkheden worden afgestemd op je ervaring en de operationele behoeften. Vragen of interesse? alla.nassaj@winsearch.be 04 72 73 08 60

review_candidates.title: Chief Executive Officer — IRx Workforce Operations
review_candidates.description: CHIEF EXECUTIVE OFFICER - IRx WORKFORCE OPERATIONS Location: Doha, Qatar (Qatar-resident) Employer: IRx Workforce Operations (QFC-incorporated JV) Reports to: JV Board, with four directors, two from each of IRx and Ashley Services Group Limited (ASG) an Australian publicly listed company. Appointment: Full General Manager and P&L responsibility, with a seat on the JV Board Package: Fixed salary, performance-related pay and equity subject to agreed vesting terms Start: On or before 1 January 2027, to coincide with incorporation. Earlier mobilisation preferred. Build a significant business. Transform workforce operations at scale. IRx and Australia's Ashley Technology Pty Ltd (part of Ashley Services Group) are seeking a Chief Executive Officer to lead IRx Workforce Operations, their joint venture bringing proven workforce management technology (ATHEXIS) to Qatar, with GCC expansionto follow. We want a leader who understands workforce-intensive businesses, has the trust of owners and executives, and can turn relationships into commercial growth. THE OPPORTUNITY The business is built on ATHEXIS, Ashley Technology’s cloud workforce and operations platform. It was developed from 12 years of operational use and is live with 90+ clients across logistics, retail, mining, construction, rail and defence. Organisations that have implemented ATHEXIS report a 33% cut in time-and-attendance admin and 42,890 overtime hours saved across its client base. ATHEXIS covers four areas: People: capacity planning, rostering with anti-double-allocation rules, mobile timesheets, and recruitment with AI candidate filtering. Assets and tasks: allocation of assets and tasks alongside people, with actual vs planned hours. Contracts: real-time costing and reporting across sites, employment agreements and jurisdictions. Compliance: qualifications, clearances, right to work and safety workflows. Workers with expired credentials are blocked from being rostered. Qatar is a strong fit. It has a large, mobile workforce, heavy compliance obligations (visas, labour regulation, accommodation, transport, supply-chain assurance), and an energy expansion that will drive major turnarounds. Much of this is still managed on spreadsheets. The JV will go to market as a Qatar company on proven international technology, tailored for Qatari operations, starting with oil and gas. It combines IRx's relationships and industrial ecosystem with Ashley Technology’s operating experience and platform. YOUR MANDATE You report to the JV Board. You are accountable for strategy, commercial results, delivery, organisation, P&L and cash. > Win Substantial Business Build a focused pipeline of 10–15 priority accounts, aiming for five or six real prospects in play at any time. Sales cycles in Qatar are long, so no single deal can carry the plan. Engage owners, CEOs and operational leaders, and lead major pursuits through to negotiation, contract signature and collection. Work with IRx's senior executives, who open doors at CEO and C-suite level. You own the relationship day to day and drive it to close. Work with Ashley Technology on technical aspects of the product and its delivery and with IRx for business operations. Lead with the customer's problem, not the product. Build business cases on cost visibility, compliance risk, productivity and capacity planning. > Build Commercial Scale Run proof-of-concept and pilot programmes, typically 12 weeks on the customer's own historical data. Qualify prospects hard so pilots convert to paid contracts. Shape pricing to each customer: subscription plus per-person or transactional fees, with consumption-based entry offers in year one. Price on value delivered, not cost to serve. Expand deployments across customer sites, contracts and business units. Cross-sell the wider IRx offering with the Board's agreement. > Lead Workforce Transformation Help customers improve deployment, utilisation, productivity, cost visibility and compliance through better workflows and realdigital adoption. Use benchmarking, such as cost per transaction or cost per unit of work, to show customers where the value is. > Deliver & Retain Build in-country first-line support and an implementation capability. Use delivery partners (typically international Systems Integrators with whom IRx have a partnership) where it makes sense, project by project. Work with Ashley Technology technical team on second and third-line support, on the roadmap and on Qatar-specific configuration. There is one global product, with no forks. Meet Qatar data-residency and security requirements, with in-country hosting and a credible path through Microsoft's ecosystem. Own deployment success, measured value, renewals and expansion. > Lead The JV Recruit and develop the team and manage budgets and margins. Year one aims to be cost-neutral, with Ashley Technology and IRx co-funding the early stage until revenue carries the business. Report clearly to the Board and bring recommendations, not just updates. Work within the Board's governance: reserved matters, dual signatories and delegated authority limits. Manage the Qatar tender mechanics, including bid and performance bonds, parent guarantees and JV capitalisation. > Win In The Qatar Market Use in-country value (ICV), Qatarisation and local-spend scoring as a commercial advantage in tenders. Engage the national ecosystem, including Tawteen, QDB, QRDI and innovation funding. Build the JV's local identity and brand with IRx and Ashley Technology. > Develop The Next Phase Qatar is the focus for 2027. Build commercially justified cases for GCC expansion, through local-partner entities where required, and for integration with the wider IRx ecosystem (for example ADAPT), as agreed with the Board. FIRST 12 MONTHS Mobilise with the JV, in post from incorporation (target 31 December 2026). Q1 2027: agree the priority account list and launch a Qatar oil and gas–tailored sandpit. Q1–Q2 2027: run at least three pilots or proofs of concept. By June 2027: sign the first paying customer. Stand up in-country hosting, support and a delivery partner model. Draft the three-year strategic plan for Board approval. About You Senior leadership in a workforce-intensive sector such as energy, construction, facilities, logistics, manpower or contracting. P&L ownership is essential. A genuine Qatar network at owner, CEO and operations level, and a track record of turning it into signed contracts. Strong understanding of Qatar business culture. Credibility and relationships matter more than any pitch. Experience selling complex, multi-stakeholder enterprise solutions with long cycles. Technology, SaaS or digital transformation experience is a strong advantage. A founder's mindset: able to start with a small team and a blank sheet, stay on every deal daily, and build the team around you. Comfortable operating on site as well as in the boardroom. Sound judgement on governance, compliance and ethics. The JV walks away from business that fails these tests. SELECTION Candidates will go through structured assessment by both Joint Venture partners.

review_candidates.title: Bookkeeper
review_candidates.description: Work arrangement: Remote within the United States. Employment type: Full-time. Position Overview The Bookkeeper role focuses on maintaining clear accounting records through routine transaction entry and account reconciliation. This full-time, United States-based remote role calls for clear communication and dependable execution. Daily assignments may be straightforward, but their quality depends on reading information accurately, organizing the next steps and documenting what has been completed. Good judgment includes knowing when to seek clarification instead of making an unsupported assumption. How The Work Is Approached Bookkeeping brings several streams of financial information together into a consistent record. The role records approved transactions, organizes payable and receivable details and reconciles statements against recorded activity. review_candidates.title: Accountant
review_candidates.description: Company Description FA Liner (Pvt.) Ltd. is an international shipping and logistics agency specializing in NVOCC operations, container trading, and specialized depot services. The company operates across major global trade lanes, supported by a robust network of international agents and strategic partnerships with ocean carriers. FA Liner focuses on efficient container fleet movement, trade logistics, and depot storage, delivering precise and reliable services to its clients. The organization emphasizes operational excellence, global coordination, and customer-focused solutions in the maritime logistics sector. Role Description This is a full-time, on-site Accountant role based in Karachi. The Accountant will manage day-to-day financial operations, including recording transactions, maintaining general ledgers, and preparing journal entries. Responsibilities include preparing and analyzing financial statements, assisting with budgeting and forecasting, and monitoring cash flows. The role will oversee accounts payable and receivable, reconcile bank and account statements, and ensure timely invoicing and payment processing. The Accountant will also support tax compliance, regulatory reporting, and internal audits, while collaborating with operations and management teams to provide accurate financial insights for decision-making. Qualifications Candidates should possess strong core accounting skills, including general ledger management, financial reporting, and account reconciliation. Candidates should possess skills in budgeting, forecasting, and financial analysis to support business planning and performance tracking. Candidates should possess proficiency with accounting software and spreadsheets, along with solid data entry and documentation capabilities. Candidates should possess knowledge of tax regulations, compliance requirements, and audit support practices. Candidates should possess effective communication, time management, and organizational skills to handle multiple deadlines and stakeholders. Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related field; professional certifications (e.g., ACCA, CA, CMA) are an advantage. Relevant experience in accounting, preferably within shipping, logistics, or related industries, is highly beneficial. Ability to work on-site in Karachi, maintain confidentiality, and uphold high ethical and professional standards.

review_candidates.title: Academies Program Manager
review_candidates.description: Company Description Work with Us. Change the World. At AECOM, we're delivering a better world. Whether improving your commute, keeping the lights on, providing access to clean water, or transforming skylines, our work helps people and communities thrive. We are the world's trusted infrastructure consulting firm, partnering with clients to solve the world’s most complex challenges and build legacies for future generations. There has never been a better time to be at AECOM. With accelerating infrastructure investment worldwide, our services are in great demand. We invite you to bring your bold ideas and big dreams and become part of a global team of over 50,000 planners, designers, engineers, scientists, digital innovators, program and construction managers and other professionals delivering projects that create a positive and tangible impact around the world. We're one global team driven by our common purpose to deliver a better world. Join us. Job Description The Academies team is part of AECOM’s broader Learning & Development team, which supports technical, digital, leadership, and talent development across the employee career journey. Together, we design and deliver personalized, relevant, connected, and applied learning experiences that build the capabilities our people need to grow their careers and deliver against AECOM’s strategic business priorities. The program manager will report to the Academies Senior Manager, who has overall accountability for the Academies portfolio. With initial guidance and oversight, the Program Manager will manage the planning and delivery of assigned global learning programs and cohort-based experiences. As experience and proficiency grow, the individual will take on increasing independence and ownership across the program lifecycle. Working alongside other program managers and program coordinators, this role will partner with subject-matter experts, business leaders, and other stakeholders to support programs from planning and preparation through delivery and evaluation. The role combines program management, learning partnership, learner experience, stakeholder coordination, and hands-on delivery. The program manager will help maintain program plans and governance, coordinate stakeholders, monitor program health and learner progress, identify risks, and escalate or help resolve challenges that affect program delivery and the learner experience. The successful candidate will be someone who can see the big picture while staying close to the details required for successful delivery. One hour could be spent analyzing learner data, managing cohort communications, resolving a learner or program issue, or reviewing program progress, and the next partnering with technical experts to plan an upcoming live discussion or work through a delivery challenge. We are a small, collaborative team supporting programs and learners globally. Everyone contributes where needed, so this role will also include program coordination, LMS administration, learner support, and live-session production support as needed to ensure successful delivery. The successful individual must demonstrate accountability, initiative, sound judgment, and a willingness to seek guidance when needed. The role is expected to build toward greater autonomy as the individual develops proficiency in the Academy operating model, stakeholder environment, and program requirements. Roles & Responsibilities Manage assigned Academy programs and cohort-based experiences across the end-to-end lifecycle, initially with guidance and oversight, including planning, preparation, delivery, and evaluation. Develop and maintain program plans, schedules, milestones, risks, dependencies, and learning event logistics, escalating issues and decisions when appropriate. Partner with SMEs and business stakeholders to understand program needs, support alignment, provide guidance within established approaches, and coordinate activities needed for successful program delivery. Coordinate program and cohort preparation, including schedules, learner and stakeholder communications, Teams channels, LMS setup, and launch activities. Support learners throughout program delivery; monitor engagement, attendance, progress, and completion requirements; manage routine learner questions and exceptions; and escalate complex or sensitive matters as appropriate. Monitor and analyze learner and program data to identify risks and challenges, recommend appropriate interventions, and provide program health and progress updates to stakeholders. Gather and analyze learner, SME, and stakeholder feedback; identify continuous improvement opportunities; and recommend or support improvements in partnership with the Academies team, instructional design team, or other L&D resources. Partner with the program coordinator and other program managers on program operations, including communications, LMS administration, learner support, reporting, evaluations, and logistics. Support and, when needed, produce global virtual learning sessions, including facilitator coordination, learner support, attendance, breakout activities, and technical logistics. This is a hybrid role, with a combination of in-office and virtual work. Qualifications Bachelor’s degree or equivalent combination of education and experience. Experience managing programs, projects, learning initiatives, or cohort-based experiences. Demonstrated program management, organization, and problem-solving skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities and stakeholders. Strong interpersonal and communication skills, with the ability to build relationships, ask thoughtful questions, provide guidance, and work collaboratively with stakeholders. Strong analytical skills with the ability to interpret data, identify challenges, and inform decisions. Excellent written and verbal communication skills. Experience with learning management systems and virtual learning environments preferred. Intermediate to advanced proficiency with Excel, including the ability to analyze, organize, and interpret program and learner data. Demonstrated proficiency with PowerPoint, Teams, and related collaboration tools. Demonstrates accountability, initiative, sound judgment, and comfort working through ambiguity, with the ability to seek guidance, incorporate feedback, and build toward greater independence. Demonstrated ability to learn new processes, tools, and stakeholder environments and apply feedback to strengthen performance. Ability to work effectively in a global, matrixed environment across cultures and time zones. Additional Information At AECOM, we are committed to maintaining a secure and trustworthy recruitment process and take any fraudulent hiring activity seriously. To support this commitment, all newly hired employees are required to attend an in-person Day 1 onboarding at an AECOM office location as a condition of employment. About AECOM AECOM is proud to offer comprehensive benefits to meet the diverse needs of our employees. Depending on your employment status, AECOM benefits may include medical, dental, vision, life, AD&D, disability benefits, paid time off, leaves of absences, voluntary benefits, perks, flexible work options, well-being resources, employee assistance program, business travel insurance, service recognition awards, retirement savings plan, and employee stock purchase plan. AECOM is the global infrastructure leader, committed to delivering a better world. As a trusted professional services firm powered by deep technical abilities, we solve our clients’ complex challenges in water, environment, energy, transportation and buildings. Our teams partner with public- and private-sector clients to create innovative, sustainable and resilient solutions throughout the project lifecycle – from advisory, planning, design and engineering to program and construction management. AECOM is a Fortune 500 firm that had revenue of $16.1 billion in fiscal year 2025. Learn more at aecom.com. What makes AECOM a great place to work You will be part of a global team that champions your growth and career ambitions. Work on groundbreaking projects - both in your local community and on a global scale - that are transforming our industry and shaping the future. With cutting-edge technology and a network of experts, you’ll have the resources to make a real impact. Our award-winning training and development programs are designed to expand your technical expertise and leadership skills, helping you build the career you’ve always envisioned. Here, you’ll find a welcoming workplace built on respect, collaboration and community - where you have the freedom to grow in a world of opportunity. As an Equal Opportunity Employer, we believe in your potential and are here to help you achieve it. All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.
